description: WCAG contrast ratio between a foreground and background color, for accessibility. Both accept a hex, CSS name, RNV brand name, or saved-palette reference. Returns the ratio (1.0-21.0) plus pass/fail for AA and AAA at normal and large text sizes and for UI components. Read-only and deterministic, with no side effects. Use this for legibility and accessibility checks; to measure raw perceptual difference between two colors rather than readability use color_difference instead.
name: contrast_check
